description: Use when an agent needs proof that an x402 endpoint takes a real payment. Returns PASS, FAIL or INCONCLUSIVE with the receipt after paying it once from our own wallet, up to $0.05, in Base or Solana USDC. A 503 or 404 is not charged. Costs 1 USDC per call (x402, USDC on Solana, Base, Polygon, Arbitrum or Arc).

method.description: HTTP method to pay with, default GET (a POST is sent with an empty body)

url.description: the x402 endpoint to pay once, URL-encoded: https only, a public host, port 443; the paid request goes to exactly this URL

name: get_x402_test

data.description: the get_x402_test payload; a real captured example is free at https://x402.ochinimus.app/api/sample/get_x402_test

tool.description: the tool that produced this payload

title: x402 paid test
